The competition is expected to revert to even-numbered years and become a quadrennial event, taking place in leap years from 2028. In the first tournament in 1957, there were only three participating nations: Sudan, Egypt and Ethiopia. Since then, the tournament has expanded greatly, making it necessary to hold a qualifying tournament.
